## Personality

Gertie Pye is known for her deceitful nature and a habit of arriving late to events, which some attribute to a desire to make her entrances more dramatic. Driven by jealousy towards Julia, she frequently makes disparaging remarks about her behind her back and takes pleasure in hearing others criticize her.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P47](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0047)_

## History

Gertie Pye was a classmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) during their time at school. At a meeting of the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society), Gertie and the other members were left distressed after learning that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) planned to rent his fence to a medicine company for advertisement purposes. She subsequently attended the meeting where an unsuccessful committee reported back after attempting to reason with Parker.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P46](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0046), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Relationships

### [Jane](../character/jane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gertie-pye--jane.md)

Gertie and Jane serve together as committee members for the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society), working alongside their peers on local community initiatives. Their shared involvement on the committee includes canvassing the [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) road to gather support for the society's goals. Together with the rest of the group, they navigate the various setbacks and challenges of trying to improve the neighborhood.

- Comrade of — fellow committee members canvassing the Carmody road (since v2)  <sub>[v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P56](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0056)</sub>
